changelog:
Race again with fresh scores and reshuffled tracks, or choose new tracks while keeping the racers.
Automatically spectate remaining racers after finishing or retiring; opt out in the regular PolyCup settings.
Practice for 1.5 times the WR on each track's first visit, with a 30-second minimum and 90-second fallback. Everyone Ready ends practice early; repeat visits skip practice.
Celebrate the winner with their car, view final standings and save a shareable results PNG.
